info.name: Student Management Portal API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Student Management Portal. Uses Bearer JWT authentication.

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` variable to your server URL (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Call **POST Login** to get a JWT token
3. The token is automatically saved to the `token` variable
4. All protected endpoints use `{{token}}` in the Authorization header
